# Paperloo Compliance Infrastructure & Autonomous Agent Hub

> Automated website compliance infrastructure, GDPR/CCPA auditing, Google Consent Mode v2, Google Tag Manager (GTM) sync, and statutory document synthesis for digital agencies and autonomous AI agents.

## When to Use This
- When your AI agent needs to automatically register and manage websites (`add_site`, `delete_site`, `list_sites`, `get_site`).
- When you need to generate legally tailored Privacy Policies, Terms of Service, Cookie Policies, and DPAs from structured questionnaire data (`get_questionnaire_schema`, `generate_docs_questionnaire`, `generate_dpa`).
- When you need to deploy and configure Google Consent Mode v2 cookie banners with unconsented tracker auto-blocking (`configure_cookie_banner`, `get_cookie_banner_script`).
- When you need to integrate Google Tag Manager with consent triggers and dataLayer updates (`configure_gtm_integration`, `get_gtm_container_setup`).
- When you need multi-vector statutory audits and live cookie inspection on any domain (`audit_site`, `scan_cookies`, `verify_compliance`).

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP
- **URL:** `https://paperloo.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- **Server Manifest:** `https://paperloo.vercel.app/server.json` and `/.well-known/mcp`
- **Supported Capabilities:** `tools`, `resources`, `prompts`

### 14 Available MCP Tools:
1. `add_site(name, url, platform, jurisdictions, agency_name)`: Provision and register a website for compliance monitoring.
2. `delete_site(siteId)`: Remove a site and cleanup audit history and banners.
3. `list_sites(filter)`: List all monitored sites with compliance grades (A+ to F).
4. `get_site(siteId)`: Retrieve complete configuration, documents, banner settings, and script snippets.
5. `get_questionnaire_schema(document_type)`: Return standardized questionnaire schema for automated question gathering.
6. `generate_docs_questionnaire(...)`: Synthesize bespoke legal policy suites using questionnaire answers.
7. `audit_site(url, deep_scan)`: Multi-vector compliance audit (GCM v2, SSL, legal links, trackers).
8. `configure_cookie_banner(...)`: Configure banner theme, position, auto-blocking, and GCM v2 sync.
9. `get_cookie_banner_script(siteId, framework)`: Generate ready-to-paste embed script.
10. `configure_gtm_integration(...)`: Link Google Tag Manager with Consent Mode v2 defaults.
11. `get_gtm_container_setup(siteId, gtm_container_id)`: Return GTM <head> and <body> snippets and trigger recipes.
12. `scan_cookies(url)`: Inventory cookies and trackers by category (Necessary, Analytics, Marketing).
13. `generate_dpa(controller_name, processor_name, governing_law, sub_processors)`: Generate GDPR Article 28 DPA contract.
14. `verify_compliance(siteId)`: Issue cryptographic compliance verification certificate and SVG badge.

## Core REST API Endpoints
All endpoints support OAuth2 Bearer tokens or public sandbox execution:
- `GET /api/health` - Server health status
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/sites` - List monitored sites
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/sites` - Register a new site
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/sites/:id` - Get site profile and configuration
- `DELETE /api/v1/compliance/sites/:id` - Delete a site
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/audit` - Multi-vector compliance audit
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/questionnaire/schema` - Legal questionnaire structure
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/generate-docs` - Generate legal documents from questionnaire
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/banner/configure` - Configure cookie banner
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/banner/script` - Get cookie banner embed script
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/gtm/configure` - Configure Google Tag Manager
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/gtm/setup` - Get GTM container code and trigger guide
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/cookies/scan` - Scan domain cookies
- `POST /api/v1/compliance/dpa/generate` - Generate GDPR Data Processing Addendum
- `GET /api/v1/compliance/verify/:id` - Verify compliance status and get certificate
- `GET /api/badge.svg` - Live SVG compliance badge
